name: Yuktravel
description: An Indonesian travel agency running a dedicated "Yuktravel Active" sports-travel arm, an official International Tour Operator for the Gold Coast Marathon for over a decade and a stated supporter of Abbott World Marathon Majors travel including Sydney, Chicago, and New York.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Yuk Travel" under Indonesia on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.

Yuktravel's own blog describes it as "Official International Tour Operator (ITO) for the TCS New York City Marathon 2026"; multiple independent search summaries of the live page corroborate this specific claim, though our fetch tool was blocked (HTTP 403) from rendering the page directly for full independent verification.
certifications.source_label: Yuktravel Blog -- TCS New York City Marathon 2026

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Yuk Travel" under Indonesia on the Sanlam Cape Town Marathon's own International Travel Program page.
certifications.source_label: Sanlam Cape Town Marathon -- International Travel Program

certifications.evidence: Listed as "Yuktravel" under Indonesia on the Bank of America Chicago Marathon's own 2026 international partners page.
certifications.source_label: Bank of America Chicago Marathon -- International partners (2026)

editorial_notes: London certification verified directly against London Marathon Events' own official tour-operator listing (as "Yuk Travel") on 2026-08-11. New York City certification is sourced from Yuktravel's own blog post (fetch blocked by the site's bot protection; corroborated via independent search-result summaries of the same page rather than a direct read). The agency's own site additionally describes a decade-long official ITO relationship with the Gold Coast Marathon and support for Sydney/Chicago Abbott World Marathon Majors travel, which we have not independently verified against those races' own organizer pages. Tokyo Marathon and Sanlam Cape Town Marathon listings (where present) checked against those races' own official travel-agency lists on 2026-10-06. Berlin and Chicago listings (where present) checked against those races' own official tour-operator lists on 2026-10-16.
